title: A Primer of the Plain Club
summary: Teaches a first-time student to grip, heft and swing a plain club using body strength alone.

title: Handbook of the Heavy Stick
summary: Sets out short daily drills for holding and swinging a heavy stick once the skin has begun to harden.

title: Drill-Book of the Knobbed Cudgel
summary: Drills the thrusts, hooks and swings that a knobbed cudgel allows, for students with firm muscle and no qi.

title: Workbook for the Watchman's Club
summary: Teaches the standing guard, crowd pressing and short strikes used by those who carry a club on watch duty.

title: Treatise on the Carried Cudgel
summary: Explains how to draw and swing a cudgel carried at the belt and to retreat from the exchange safely.

title: Lessons in the Short Bludgeon
summary: Introduces a newly awakened student to timing short, hard club blows with the first breath of circulating qi.

title: Canon of the Oaken Club
summary: Teaches a Senior student to let the dense weight of an oaken club carry each qi-timed blow.

title: The Ironwood Drill Manual
summary: Drills striking, pinning and stepping with a club of ironwood, built on steady breath and measured pace.

title: Handbook of the Weighted Cudgel
summary: Shows how a cudgel with a heavy head swings like a pendulum when a Senior student lends it qi.

title: Field Primer of the Hand Club
summary: Teaches close-range striking and blocking with a short hand club, for students who circulate their own qi.

title: Treatise on the Two-Hand Cudgel Grip
summary: Teaches the split-hand grip of a long cudgel and the thrusts, blocks and falling strokes it gives.
